user.t:
For the venture at C:\Users\mariu\ventures\merchant-fee-audit: add an INVESTOR page to its marketing site, then publish the site PUBLICLY via GitHub Pages while keeping the backend repo PRIVATE. NO ruflo/ruvnet. Do NOT change backend/application code. Do NOT change the backend repo's visibility.

STEP 1 — INVESTOR PAGE (added to marketing/site, static, zero-dependency like the rest of the site):
- Build an "Investors" page + linked sub-pages rendering the repo's EXISTING docs: business plan, market analysis, financial model, marketing plan, hiring plan, and legal. READ the repo's business/ financial/ technical/ fundraising/ hiring/ marketing/ dirs and render their real content as static HTML. Do NOT invent numbers or traction.
- HONESTY (mandatory): label the financial model clearly as "ILLUSTRATIVE PROJECTIONS / ASSUMPTIONS — not audited financial statements; pre-product; no revenue or customers yet." Keep the report's own ranking/verdict (e.g. DEFER/MAYBE) and any "do not raise" note from the repo's fundraising doc VERBATIM — do NOT remove or soften them. No fabricated metrics, logos, testimonials, customers, or valuation.
- SECURITIES DISCLAIMER on every investor page: "Informational only. Not an offer to sell or a solicitation to buy any security. Pre-product. Forward-looking statements are illustrative assumptions, not predictions of actual results." 
- Keep it consistent with the site's design tokens; it must pass the marketing build-check (banned claims etc.). Update the build-check if needed so it still enforces honesty (and does not flag the investor disclaimers).

STEP 2 — PUBLISH (same safe method as the earlier 11 live sites):
- Build the static site. Publish ONLY the static output to a public repo `socrates6969/merchant-fee-audit-site` (create public if missing, else update), enable GitHub Pages, set SITE_URL to the Pages URL so canonical/sitemap are correct, add .nojekyll. Do NOT push backend/src. Confirm the backend repo socrates6969/merchant-fee-audit is still PRIVATE afterward.
- Keep the "Created by Marius Carlsson / socrates6969" footer; commit authored as Marius Carlsson <[REDACTED:email]> ending with "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <[REDACTED:email]>". If a push is DENIED, STOP and report it (do not work around a denial).
Return: the live Pages URL, confirmation the backend stayed private, what docs the investor page includes, and the honesty/disclaimer measures applied.
